Overview.Name: Rama Krishna
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + paneer cubes (120 g)
Meal_2 (Dinner - balanced): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + small fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with paneer or curd before eating rice.
Avoid sweets as they affect thyroid balance and fat loss.
Keep meals simple and consistent to support daily energy.
Field work needs steady energy, so do not skip meals.
Consistency will improve stamina, body shape and overall energy.
